profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Publix
profile.summary:
Over 14 years SAP project leadership, including solution development & design, configuration, implementation, testing, defect resolution, and training/post-live support. Solid technical proficiency, combined with a strong background in management, business operations, finance, and accounting. Reputation for conducting in-depth analyses and translating complex data into mission-critical solutions and process improvements. 

Natural team leader; expertly train and support global teams. Cement relationships with users and key stakeholders through consistent communication and status updates. SAP Security experience complemented by 9 years of finance and accounting functional background.

positions.title: SAP Security Lead
positions.description:
SAP Security Lead accountable for design, configuration/development, testing and deployment of ERP solution with SAP S/4HANA at the core using leading implementation practices and software development lifecycle principles.

Collaborates with system integration partner to deliver S/4 HANA, SAP TPM, SAP BW and SAP GRC Access Controls Implementation with regard to security policy and role/user access assignments. Focus on role creation and maintenance, audit support, policy compliance, and user assignment enabling the proper governance, risk and controls for applications, systems, platforms, and services. Ensures compliance with corporate policy and SAP standard methodology with regard to security settings.

KEY RESULTS:

- Develop GRC workflows and approval process to implement appropriate controls while minimizing custom configuration
- Ensure GRC configuration and security process and procedures are documented and align with IT General Controls
- Develop elevate access process for cutover activities and post production support to monitor, review and properly remove access

positions.title: Engineer, Info Security - SAP
positions.description:
Designed and facilitated implementation of information security and IT controls within enterprise SAP implementations and provide troubleshooting support throughout the project lifecycle. Responsible for understanding requirements, creating designs, developing, testing, implementing and documenting security roles.

KEY RESULTS: 

- Served as a security lead for Solution Manager 7.2 upgrade; advising security project resource regarding design, defect resolution and UAT testing; reviewed and remediated SAP Solution Manager Administration Support roles to remove critical authorization objects
- Security Lead on AR Optimization Project to create security roles for custom cash application and collection & disputes application; interpreted and documented custom authorization object structure; performed defect resolution during all test cycles providing a smooth go live

positions.title: SAP Security Deployment Lead - Contractor
positions.description:
Managed of all security related activities around deploying users onto CONA applications, including SAP Netweaver Portal, SAP ECC, SAP APO, SAP SRM, SAP CRM, SAP BW, SAP HANA, SAP Xmii, Hyland OnBase, Tableau and Active Directory using IdM for provisioning. 

Created methodologies and processes that enabled local security teams to maintain CONA security solution independently once hyper care support ended. Validated user access mappings for deployments based on job position/specific security business roles.

KEY RESULTS:

- Provided training, defect resolution during User Acceptance Testing and Dry Run Testing, assisted with go live incident resolution, and demonstrated Service Now reporting and tracking to prepare local team for post go live.
- Coordinated Process Owner approvals and documented job position to business role mapping for deployments; enabled automated Job Based Business Role provisioning through IdM after all approvals were obtained.
- Maintained relationships with customers and internal stakeholders; managed timelines; and monitored tasks and delivery of other contracted resources to drive on-time deployments.

company.name: CONA Services - A Coca-Cola System IT Services Company

positions.title: Consultant - SAP Security Architect
positions.description:
Directed all facets of security role design, build, security testing, dry run support, and post go live support for new bottler SAP ECC implementation. Carried out security functions for development and production systems. Served as subject matter expert (SME) for Solution Manager. 

Developed audit queries, determined authorizations in security roles, and conducted evaluations of custom-developed Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) programs. Implemented Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) risk analysis to mitigate segregation of duties (SoD) conflicts.

•	Served as implementation lead for Solution Manager 7.1 ChaRM; supervised project team and personally handled security development, configuration, and design, while completing other day-to-day priorities. 
•	Led new SAP ECC implementation to guarantee timely completion of security role build and user administration tasks; successfully actualized the implementation.  
•	Trained and supported SAP Security shared services team in Philippines with assessment of system changes; ensured compliance with audit and company policy.
•	Guaranteed accurate assigning of tickets and resolution within established service level agreements; directly oversaw production support, post go-live issues, and testing defects in various tracking tools.

positions.title: SAP Business Analyst
positions.description:
Recruited as technical subject matter expert (SME) and collaborated with third-party vendors during the blue print phase of a third-party software (OpenText and Open Scan) implementation. Enhanced processes by educating management on SAP functionality for the streamlining of transaction processing and reporting. 

Created PowerPoint training course on SAP basic functionality; presented an introduction and explanation of the system to promote development of new users. Facilitated classroom training for Basic SAP, purchase orders, accounts payable, and general ledger. Conducted additional training and development through site visits and group training sessions.

KEY RESULTS:

•	Rendered front-line finance and purchasing support to over 500 SAP end-users including transaction processing, additional training, and recommending strategic business process improvement initiatives.
•	Administered fixed assets in SAP for more than 50 locations encompassing the formulation of master data, depreciation, capitalization, transfers, and disposal of assets.
•	Systematically downloaded data from legacy system while mapping new accounts to be uploaded to SAP, which included actual and budget profit and loss accounts, accounts payable, and accounts receivable; offered guidance to controllers regarding account balancing and mapping validation.
•	Created and facilitated a monthly “SAP Call-In Hour”; provided a forum for end users and other business stakeholders to raise general SAP concerns and ask transactional-based questions.
•	Reduced repeat requests for assistance; formulated work instructions documenting appropriate resolution for user issues reported to the help desk; posted solutions on SharePoint on benefit the rest of the user community.

positions.title: SAP Secuity Analyst & Accounting Manager
positions.description:
Configured security job-based user roles by interacting with Process Teams, Change Management, Training, and Integration Teams (including Unit Testing Team and Business Process Owners). Developed and maintained test scripts in Solution Manager; managed frontline support for end-user defects; communicated issues to management to build cooperation from other Process Team members; and rapidly resolved issues within service level agreements.

KEY RESULTS:

•	Assumed full accountability for processing access requests and assigning security roles in accordance with job roles.
•	Streamlined verification of user requests and training requirements by developing an Excel database linking job roles, required training, and business process owners; simplified security user administration tasks and training verification.
•	Observed strict conformance with SAP security policies and procedures related to implementation efforts and security standards; and provided training and support to process teams/support personnel on those policies and procedures.
•	Performed comprehensive analysis on custom-developed ABAP/4 programs to guarantee the inclusion of authority checking modules prior to the integration of programs.
